status: fourteenth aggregation slice: non-permanent evidence merges are memoized by term-id pair, cutting the merge phase 25% on TodoMVC and giving the largest end-to-end gain of the late batch (TodoMVC -2.4%/-2.9% diagnostics)

change.what: merge_type_evidence memoizes the non-permanent path keyed by (left.0, right.0) when both operands already have a non-variable head, returning the cached result on a repeat and storing it otherwise. The permanent path (which equates variables) and variable-headed operands skip the memo.
change.why: counting duplicate pairs before implementing showed the merge repeats itself constantly: NovyWave 137,287 of 154,361 non-permanent calls (89%) and TodoMVC 266,183 of 290,548 (92%) recompute a pair that was already merged.
change.soundness: the guard matters: resolve_term_head follows a variable head's binding chain, so only operands that are not variables have a binding-independent result. With that guard the path never binds a variable itself and every recursive step goes through structural_widen, which lives in the term arena and cannot read solver bindings — it is a cached pure function of its two term ids. Variable-headed operands keep taking the uncached path (structural_widen already caches them internally), and the permanent path is never memoized.

phase_probe_release.note: single observations per build; the merge phase is the signal

paired_ab.protocol: twelve rounds per cell, both binaries back to back with alternating order, one process per observation
paired_ab.reading: every TodoMVC cell moves in the same direction with round deltas of the same sign, which is the clearest end-to-end signal of this batch; NovyWave diagnostics improves slightly, verified is flat

position: NovyWave's refresh is ~63 ms: contributor check 14.9, merge 12.2, order 7.5, deps 4.8, collection/invalidation/commit ~5.6 and the rest bookkeeping. The memo costs about 400 KB of retained pairs on NovyWave and a few hundred KB on TodoMVC.
caveats: the non-variable-head guard is what makes the memo sound, so a future change that lets merge_type_evidence read bindings through another path must revisit the memo
cold modes only; the warm path is the successor goal
